members.instructions: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to support chat. What is the customer's specific issue or request?

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment/purchase or charge on my account that I don't recognise or didn't make (unknown merchant, charge I didn't make)
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash/ATM withdrawal on my account that I didn't make, don't recognise, or whose cash I never received
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit payment I don't recognise or didn't set up, or want to dispute or get refunded
criteria.compromised_card: Card details may be compromised or someone else used my card (suspected fraud, card misuse)
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: My card was lost or stolen; reporting it or freezing it
criteria.found_lost_card: Found a card I had reported lost and want to reactivate it or add it back to the app
criteria.lost_card_replacement_cost: Asks whether a replacement for a lost card will cost anything
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: My phone was lost, stolen or left somewhere (e.g. at a hotel); protecting or using the app/account without it
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot or need to reset the app passcode; can't log into the app
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked or card locked after wrong PIN attempts
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase / to get money back from a merchant
criteria.refund_not_showing_up: A merchant refund hasn't appeared on my account yet
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Charged twice / duplicate charge for one purchase
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave less cash than requested / wrong amount dispensed / didn't get all the cash I wanted
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment I made was reverted, returned or cancelled (by the app or merchant), or I can't find a payment I made, or my payment was terminated
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra fee or small extra charge (e.g. extra £1) on my statement, not tied to a specific card payment, transfer or ATM use
criteria.cancel_purchase: Wants to cancel a purchase or order from a merchant
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer or transaction already made, or fix a transfer sent to the wrong account
criteria.get_first_pin: Getting, finding or understanding my card PIN: setting the PIN for a new or physical card, where to find my PIN, I don't have a PIN, general questions about the PIN
criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a new card
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring; getting a replacement
criteria.card_acceptance: Where/which merchants or ATMs accept my card
criteria.card_arrival: My ordered card hasn't arrived yet
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes; delivery date, tracking, shipping
criteria.card_linking: Link / add a card to the app
criteria.change_pin: Change, reset or update an existing card PIN; I forgot my PIN; where/which ATMs to change the PIN
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment or purchase was declined / rejected
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM cash withdrawal was declined / couldn't withdraw cash
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Virtual or disposable virtual card not working / rejected
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Getting a disposable virtual card; what they are
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits on disposable virtual cards (number of uses, how many)
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get / order / access a virtual card
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card; card fees, ordering from abroad
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional / second / spare card
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the bank's card is Visa or Mastercard; which cards the bank offers or carries; choosing one; whether Visa/Mastercard can be used
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs I can use; ATM questions
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay / Google Pay, including topping up with Apple Pay or Google Pay
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending / hasn't gone through
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal is still pending or not cleared, or my balance looks wrong after an ATM withdrawal
criteria.transaction_receipt: Wants a receipt, proof or confirmation of a transfer or money transaction
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Can't add a beneficiary, or a transfer/payment to a payee or crypto exchange is not allowed or won't go through
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into my account from another bank
criteria.unexplained_incoming_money: Reports money appearing in my account that I didn't put there (suspicious, unauthorised)
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money / salary into the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Balance didn't update after a bank transfer in
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Cheque or cash deposit not showing in balance
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or cheque
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Steps for how to top up using a card; ways or apps to top up; using a credit card to transfer money
criteria.top_up_reverted: Top-up was reverted / returned; money I added has vanished or disappeared from my balance
criteria.verify_top_up: Top-up verification code / why top-ups need verifying
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards can be used to top up: card brands, other cards, foreign cards (e.g. a US card), whether my card is supported or accepted for top-ups; which currencies top-ups accept (not Apple Pay / Google Pay questions)
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Fee charged on a card payment or purchase; why some payments have fees
criteria.atm_abroad_fee_or_rate: Fees for withdrawing cash from an ATM abroad / in a different country
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for an ATM cash withdrawal (domestic or unspecified)
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up with a card (incl. international card)
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer: How to top up / add money by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up by bank transfer/SEPA
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Fee charged for a transfer; fees on receiving money; whether money sent to me arrives in full
criteria.exchange_rate: How exchange rates are set / what rate I get
criteria.exchange_charge: What fees apply to currency exchange (general question)
criteria.exchange_overcharged: Complaint that a currency exchange cost too much / was overcharged
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies can be held / exchanged; salary in another currency
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card purchase abroad
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Exchange rate for cash withdrawals: the rate applied to cash I withdrew was wrong, or what exchange/weekend rates apply when getting cash
criteria.age_limit: Age requirements to open an account
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service or cards are available in; whether people living outside the UK can sign up or get a card
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; which documents are needed
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification not working / app can't recognise me
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Source of funds: verifying where my money comes from, or asking where some money came from
